parsed.why: 2024 reading-down decriminalises private adult conduct, but statute survives, no gender-identity protection, police dismissive of anti-LGBT violence, tourists targeted, killing recorded. No trans-specific data: extrapolate societal hostility with thin recourse. Elevated risk.

Legal since 1977, gender-identity hate-crime law, documentable recognition, LGBT centres, Pride, guide reports wide acceptance. But enforcement gaps, inadequate hate-crime investigations, anti-gender political hostility. No facility or border restriction. Reduced risk.

Sodomy statute carries 14 years, sporadically enforced; police documented as main source of violence against trans people, rape and beatings with impunity, victims recast as perpetrators. Third-gender tradition and coastal sanctuary, but severe unremedied targeting dominates.

State-imposed universal exposure: passport/visa marker refusal, possible lifetime fraud bar, foreign-government advisories, criminal bathroom laws with an arrest, birth-sex custody and immigration-detention abuse. Courts enforce hostile policy, so no mitigation.

2025 decriminalisation ends criminal exposure; domestic-violence act explicitly covers gender identity and gives trans victims equal protection orders, plus police/customs sensitisation. Offset by documented attacks on foreign sexual minorities and sole regional opposition to UN SOGI declaration.
